lines: {target}? Dry cliffs make every mistake echo. I would count everyone twice.
If anyone heads for Badlands, tell them: Carry water and watch the ledges. I'll be at the loom.
Red sand and terracotta do not soften a fall. I'll remember that when I count everyone.
Badlands is no small story. Fear scatters folk like a loose flock.
I will remember Badlands as hard country with old color in its bones. I will count heads before I count sheep.
